content.intro_text: The fastest and simplest tool to format the case (uppercase and lowercase) of your text.
content.usage_title: How to use the Online Text Case Converter?
content.step_1: Enter Text: Copy and paste or type the text you want to format in the designated text area.
content.step_2: Select Formatting: Click on the icon corresponding to the desired style:
content.type_lower_text: Converts all text to lowercase letters.
content.type_upper_text: Converts all text to uppercase letters.
content.type_sentence_text: Converts the text with the first letter of each sentence in uppercase.
content.type_troll_text: Converts the text by alternating between uppercase and lowercase letters.
content.step_3: Copy Result: The formatted text is displayed instantly in the result field for you to copy.
content.benefits_title: What are the benefits of a Text Case Converter?
content.benefits_intro: A text case converter is extremely useful for:
content.benefit_1_text: Ensuring that an entire document follows the required standard format (e.g., titles in UPPERCASE or body text in lowercase).
content.benefit_2_text: Quickly correcting text accidentally typed with Caps Lock on or without proper capitalization at the beginning of sentences.
content.benefit_3_text: Creating attention-grabbing headlines (with UPPERCASE) or unique social media posts (TROLL style) for better engagement.
content.benefit_4_text: Formatting blocks of text to improve readability and visual organization.
content.footer_text: Standardize your writing and save time on editing with the Text Case Converter!
